decision_conditions:
S73 - CONSENT LIMITED TO THAT OF ORIGINAL PERMISSION: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of 15 November 2027. 

REASON: To ensure the commencement timescale for the development is not extended beyond that of the original planning permission granted on 15 November 2024 (LBI reference P2024/2403/FUL). Furthermore, to comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
description: Variation of condition 2 (drawings) of planning permission ref. P2024/2403/FUL dated 15/11/2024 'the construction of a new extension at third floor/roof level, installation of lift to an existing void, alterations to front and rear facades including amendments to cladding and windows, installation of a new larger skylight to first floor roof, installation of screen around existing roof terrace and relocation of AC units to main roof.’ This variation seeks alterations to massing and treatment of consented roof extension and alterations to front elevation.
